newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador plans "complaints" over Peru arrests.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador plans "complaints" over Peru arrests.

text.p: Ecuador's Defence Ministry said Wednesday it would make diplomatic complaints after Peru arrested members of an Ecuadorean patrol in a disputed border zone over which the two countries went to war in 1995.
Seven Ecuadorean soldiers carrying out "normal and routine patrol activities" were captured by the Peruvians Tuesday morning in the Paquisha Alto border zone, the ministry said.

It said the captured men would be handed over to Ecuador in the next few hours by an international peace mission, known by its Spanish initials MOMEP, which monitors compliance of a provisional peace treaty.
The ministry said it would prepare a report on events "in order to enact complaints through diplomatic channels."
The Ecuadorean patrol "was intercepted by Peruvian troops and taken to the Ciro Alegria military base, thereby failing to comply with security rules on military activities in the area," it said.
The incident came as Ecuadorean and Peruvian officials were set to start a second round of talks on their border disputes in Brasilia.

The two countries fought a month-long war in January 1995 over a stretch of their jungle border. Dozens of soldiers were killed and hundreds injured from both sides in the fighting, which followed a long border dispute.
